label: World of Hyatt
short_description: From Park Hyatt's five-star suites to Hyatt Place's efficient business rooms.
intro: World of Hyatt is Hyatt Hotels Corporation's loyalty program, spanning brands from ultra-luxury (Park Hyatt, Alila, The Unbound Collection by Hyatt) through full-service upscale (Grand Hyatt, Hyatt Regency, Andaz, Thompson Hotels) to select-service options (Hyatt Place, Hyatt Centric, Caption by Hyatt). Elite status tiers -- Discoverist, Explorist, and Globalist -- unlock benefits like room upgrades, lounge access, and free breakfast, but exactly which perks a given hotel actually delivers varies by property and brand tier. This directory tracks that property-by-property reality rather than the program's general terms.

faqs.question: Does every World of Hyatt hotel offer the same elite benefits?
faqs.answer: No -- elite benefits like lounge access, breakfast, and upgrade likelihood vary significantly by hotel and brand tier, even at the same status level. A Globalist member gets a stronger experience at a full-service Grand Hyatt or Park Hyatt than at a select-service Hyatt Place, and each hotel profile here notes what that property specifically provides.

faqs.question: How are these World of Hyatt hotel reviews put together?
faqs.answer: Each listing combines verified property facts (address, brand, elite benefit details) with synthesized commentary drawn from public guest reviews and reporting, refreshed on a regular schedule. Every page shows when it was last checked and how many sources informed it.
